scope: Proposition 10.2 (The generic diagonal homotopy) of the manuscript “Failure of finite assembly for a chromatic overlap at the prime three” (preprints/Failure-of-finite-assembly-for-a-chromatic-overlap-at-the-prime-three-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1e58a49eb364dd8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 67. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The diagonal spectral sequence of Proposi- tion 8.3, after extension of scalars to Qx, collapses at its second page. For every r ∈ Z, its actual abutment filtration gives GF -equivariant short exact sequences 0 −→ Qx(δ) ⊗Qx ω⊗(r+2) −→ V∆ 2r(Zk) −→ ω⊗r −→ 0, (10.4) 0 −→ Qx(δ) ⊗Qx ω⊗(r+1) −→ V∆ 2r−1(Zk) −→ ω⊗r −→ 0. (10.5) In particular, each diagonal summand V∆ d (Zk) has dimension two over Qx, and V∆ −3(Zk) contains a subrepresentation isomorphic to Qx(δ).
